examples.name: Default
examples.summary: An empty, `clearable` rating bound with `v-model`: one tab stop, the arrow keys move the score, the clear button resets it to 0.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.summary: `size` small, medium and large: 16, 20 and 24 px stars in 24, 28 and 32 px targets, 44 px on a touch screen.

examples.name: Readonly
examples.summary: `readonly` shows averages to the nearest half star, announced as one image ("Rated 4.5 out of 5"); the review count stays in text beside it.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: `disabled` keeps the score visible and takes every star and the clear button out of the tab order.

examples.name: InField
examples.summary: A support satisfaction (CSAT) question inside a `Field`: the title names the group, the description explains the scale, and an empty submit shows the error.
